messages:
Ana: Quick ask from EU bank PoC — they need evidence we can do tenant-level segmentation, per-tenant KMS, and a clear dataflow diagram that includes an on-prem connector. Also want the full subprocessor list for Europe. Can we confirm what artifacts we can hand over and ETA?

Jess: We support tenant segmentation via Redwood Private (private control plane) or Dedicated with network isolation. For the POC we can generate a tenant-architecture diagram and config snippet. Per-tenant KMS is available on Private; Dedicated can use customer-managed KMS with some setup.

Mike: I'll pull the subprocessor csv and the hosting boundary sketch. One note: our hosted API paths use eu-west-1 for model hosting by default for EU customers unless they ask for Private.

Oliver: Security checklist — need to confirm: 1) Do we ever persist prompts for training? 2) What logs are sent to external vendors (Sentry/Datadog)? 3) Which vendors process plaintext request bodies in EU? I'll verify and tag legal for vendor contract visibility.

Ana: They explicitly asked about "no cross-border copies" for raw user content. Also asked if we can provide a diagram showing that the on-prem connector only forwards tokens to the model and doesn't store them.

Jess: Short answers: we do not train on customer prompts by default (opt-in only, and it's explicitly handled as a separate flow). Audit logs exist and retention is configurable. For POC we can produce: dataflow.svg (annotated path), a short config snippet showing VPC peering + routing, and a statement on training data policy.

Mike: Drafted the subprocessor list — current EU-affecting vendors: AWS (eu-west-1), Fastly (CDN edge), Datadog (metrics, EU region), Sentry (error reporting, EU org), Cloudflare (optional). I'll scrub contract-sensitive fields, then upload.

Oliver: For KMS: we support Cloud KMS integrations (customer project) in Private. HSM-level key custody is on roadmap for on-prem installs. Note: per-tenant KMS for Dedicated requires SRE assistance.

Ana: Perfect. Can we get the artifacts for the customer POC: 1) redacted subprocessor csv, 2) hosting boundary + packet flow diagram (SVG/PDF), 3) short statement on training/retention, 4) sample config for VPC peering? ETA = EOD tomorrow would be ideal.

Mike: @legal can you quick-check whether we can share the redacted vendor names/contracts? If yes I'll upload to the shared presales drive.

legal: I can approve sharing a redacted list (vendor names + jurisdiction + purpose) but not contract copies. We'll need NDA-guarded release for contracts.

deploy-bot: Uploaded artifacts to presales-bundles/sales-eu-bank/2045012345/: dataflow.svg, tenant-config-snippet.txt, subproc-redacted.csv, training-policy.pdf — https://storage.redwood.internal/presales-bundles/2045012345 (internal link) :white_check_mark:

Ana: Thanks everyone — I'm going to send the bundle to the customer and propose a short walkthrough next week. If anything else pops up I'll @channel. :thumbsup:
